svg.title: Figure 8-3: The stage-gate checklist
svg.desc: A checklist table with four columns, one per stage transition: into prove, into scale, into embed and into maintenance. Each column lists the questions that must be answered before the initiative proceeds to that stage.
svg.text: All gates: reviewed by someone independent of the team that ran the current stage
Stage-gates prevent momentum from substituting for evidence.
A gate passed by the same person who ran the stage is not a gate.
